note: Cached canonical HTML contract essentials from learn_post_authoring. Reuse across daily runs.

established_template.reference_draft: Template Newsletter (post_c0cde14a-1804-4b10-8615-2f17a1a9507a) and the live daily series (e.g. post_64d371c4 from 2026-11-22).
established_template.description: AI Current dark theme. Each block wrapped in a node-section div with data-background-color #222222; text sections also set data-color #FFFFFF; padding 20 (18 for section-image blocks). Cover image is a 16:9 imageBlock figure with 30px rounded corners. Structure: cover -> intro paragraph ('Good morning. It's <day>, <date>...') -> for each category: h2 heading section + 16:9 category image section (no rounding) + story paragraphs section (bold lead sentence + source link) -> sign-off paragraph -> full-width 'Share AI Current' button linking to {{rp_referral_hub_url}}.

ad_nodes.notes: Place ads AFTER creating the post, one at a time, via edit_post_content; do NOT set data-advertisement-kind (lets server assign). Use fresh ids from list_ad_offers (available_offers auto-claim on placement). Accepted opportunities already in another post cannot be reused. IMPORTANT: ad network caps this publication at 2 placements per post; a 3rd fails with 'can not accept any more opportunities' / 'No primary ad slot available'.

recipients_note: Publication has no paid tier (list_tiers = 0); save_post defaults to free tier on web+email, which matches prior sends. No override needed.
